summary: Determines a window control type (0, 1 or 2) stored at this+0x30C by comparing the path string at this+0xB8 (falling back to the default path byte_5EA438 when null) against three reference strings via sub_588410. All three comparisons run sequentially and the last write wins; returns 0.

operations.description: Read the path string pointer at this+0xB8; when it is null use the default path byte_5EA438.
Compare the path pointer against reference string byte_5CC21C via sub_588410; when the comparison returns zero, write control type 0 to this+0x30C.
Compare the path pointer against reference string aR via sub_588410; when the comparison returns zero, write control type 1 to this+0x30C.
Compare the path pointer against reference string aC_0 via sub_588410; when the comparison returns zero, write control type 2 to this+0x30C.
Return 0 after all three sequential comparisons; the value left at this+0x30C is the last matching case (or unchanged if no comparison wrote it).
